background: HSBC UK Bank plc is the ring-fenced retail and commercial bank of HSBC in Britain, funded by UK personal and business deposits and lending on residential mortgages and to UK companies, including first direct.
synthesis: Rated AA- on average across all three, the weakest of them at A+, two on a positive outlook and one on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026, the ring-fenced bank is among the best-rated UK lenders. Liquidity is the strength, with LCR of 160% above the UK majors' median and NSFR of 143% in the top quarter, and leverage of 5.6% is also in the top quarter, though CET1 of 13.2% is in the bottom quarter. Liquidity has come down from a high level, with LCR down 26 points and NSFR down 8 points since 30 Jun 2025, while CET1 and leverage have been broadly flat. The flagged news, the newest on 7 Oct 2026, is about job cuts in the UK wealth business.
